name: spark-ds41f
description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on DGX Spark (TP4 ring or TP3 triangle, TileLang, one-shot RoCE collectives). GLP spec_version 3 fold-site steering: the weightless served name runs beside the stock one.

glp.note: The recipe pins repo/revision/file/sha256 in config/cluster.json and its doctor validates the vector on every node before launch. The default serves msuiche/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-abliterated-cyber-GLP-27-L11-37-a3.5 (GLP spec 3, L11-37, alpha 3.5).

probe.note: A/B one refusal-class prompt across the two served names; the weightless name is the steered arm.
